verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Mercury's own business banking product and API/CLI/MCP for managing a single Mercury account (balances, transactions, invoices, cards), not a Banking-as-a-Service program that lets a developer issue embedded accounts to their own end customers under Mercury's banking license. No evidence pack item mentions sponsor-bank/BaaS partnerships, sub-account issuance for third-party customers, or a license-pass-through program.
